requirements.clause: The customer can navigate to the Wishlist page via 'My Account > Wishlist' in the dashboard sidebar.
requirements.groundingNote: Verified live 2026-08-21 — see D-009. Sidebar shows Dashboard / My Account / Wishlist / Order History / Order Report / Restock Requests / Pre-Orders / Notices.

requirements.clause: The customer can navigate to the Wishlist page via the wishlist icon in the site header navbar.
requirements.groundingNote: Verified live 2026-08-21 — see D-009. Header link: a.ico-wishlist.header-link-wishlist, href=/wishlist, with a (n) count badge. Both REQ-01 and REQ-02 resolve to the same page (/wishlist -> /korean-wishlist), so they must be tested as two independent entry points to one destination, not two separate pages.

requirements.clause: When the Wish List page loads with saved products, each is displayed as a product card showing item details and a remove action.
requirements.groundingNote: Confirmed live — see D-010. Product card on /korean-wishlist shows: name, price, a Remove button (button.wishlist-remove-btn, onclick=removeWishlistItem(wishlistItemId, this)), and an Add to cart button.

requirements.clause: When the customer has no products in their wishlist, the Wish List page displays the message "Your wishlist is empty." and a "Browse products →" button that links to the home page.
requirements.groundingNote: Verified live 2026-08-21 on the test account (empty wishlist) — verbatim text "Your wishlist is empty." confirmed present on /korean-wishlist.

requirements.clause: When the customer clicks the "♡ Wishlist" button on a product card or product detail page, the product is added to the wishlist and a success message is displayed.
requirements.groundingNote: RESOLVED via live verification — see D-010. Verbatim success message: "The product has been added to your wishlist" (bar notification). Button: #add-to-wishlist-button-{productId}. AJAX POST /addproducttocart/details/{productId}/2. Requires a real trusted click, not a JS-dispatched one.

requirements.clause: After a product is added to the wishlist, the wishlist count shown in the header updates to reflect the new total.
requirements.groundingNote: Confirmed live — see D-010. span.wishlist-qty inside a.header-link-wishlist went (0) -> (1) immediately after the AJAX response for adding product id 63.
